acceptance: Pinned official Linux x86_64 ai-memory 2.3.2 archive, sidecar, executable and license match
Native scoped writes, reads, FTS positives and cross-scope negatives match the public synthetic bodies
Unicode path and updated alpha persist through restart and native backup/restore
Native source-generated archive transfers through exact encrypted Restic snapshot to a distinct fresh hosted destination
Destination native restore and real MCP reads/queries reproduce exact source fixture bodies, scope negatives, old-marker absence and SQLite integrity
No captured history, embeddings or downloaded model files; all owned processes stop
stop_conditions: source, artifact or binary hash mismatch
execution_scope: Local integration of public synthetic state with pinned native operations; no production state, provider calls, client registration, OS sandbox or upstream-test authorship claim.

backup_restore.on_refusal: Retain native exit, no retry, no process enumeration or unrelated signals, empty restore target unchanged.
backup_restore.on_success: Exact updated scoped bodies and FTS, Unicode, negatives, capture-off, database integrity.
